summary: QuasarEdge Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the ordinary shares and rights starting May 7, 2026. This routine administrative step following an IPO allows unit holders to split components for individual trading on the NYSE. No terms, premiums, advisor, or board recommendation are mentioned. This is not a special-situation event but a standard separability notification. Watch for no risk-arb angle; purely procedural.
